# openmetadata_domain (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata Domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_domain" "analytics" {
  name         = "Analytics"
  display_name = "Analytics"
  description  = "Owns reporting and BI data products."
  domain_type  = "Aggregate"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the resource.
- `domain_type` (String) Type of the domain. Must be one of: Source-aligned, Consumer-aligned, Aggregate.
- `name` (String) Unique name identifying the resource.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `experts` (Attributes List) Users who are experts for this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--experts))
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent domain. When null, indicates a top-level domain.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the resource.
- `id` (String) UUID of the resource assigned by OpenMetadata.

<a id="nestedatt--experts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `experts`

Required:

- `id` (String) UUID of the expert user.
- `type` (String) Type of the expert entity (user).


<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Required:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner entity (user or team).
